sources.title: JEDEC standards scope: High Bandwidth Memory
used_for: HBM is a JEDEC-standardized memory family
interface standards do not provide vendor manufacturing cost or GDS
sources.limitations: The detailed JESD235 document may require JEDEC access; no proprietary layout or cost data is inferred.

sources.title: Samsung Starts Producing 8-Gigabyte High Bandwidth Memory-2
sources.limitations: Product announcement, not a detailed power, die-area, yield, or cost disclosure.

sources.title: Samsung Launches 16GB HBM2E Flashbolt
used_for: more than 5,600 TSV-related holes per die
sources.limitations: HBM2E cross-check only; counts cannot be treated as an exact HBM2 pin map.

sources.title: Creating New Values in DRAM Using TSV Technology
used_for: TSV pitch/diameter/aspect ratio, die thinning, and assembly yield are scaling challenges
sources.limitations: Technology overview; does not disclose manufacturing yield or price.

sources.title: Samsung Develops Industry's First HBM with AI Processing Power
used_for: HBM-PIM is a real manufacturer research direction
PIM benefits must be evaluated at workload/system level
sources.limitations: Marketing-level performance claims are not used as calibrated project inputs.

sources.title: CACTI 7.0: cache, memory, 3D stacking and off-chip I/O model
sources.limitations: Technology-node and organization assumptions differ from a proprietary HBM2 implementation; not directly executed by the default pipeline.

sources.title: McPAT: An Integrated Power, Area, and Timing Modeling Framework
sources.limitations: Processor model precedent, not an HBM manufacturing cost model.

sources.title: Yield Enhancement for 3D-Stacked ICs: Recent Advances and Challenges
used_for: separate die, bonding and TSV yield factors
known-good-die, pre-bond test and TSV redundancy rationale
sources.limitations: Provides modeling structure, not current vendor-specific HBM2 yield parameters.

sources.title: Yield Improvement for 3D Wafer-to-Wafer Stacked Memories
used_for: stacked-die yield and interconnect yield must both be represented
sources.limitations: Generic stacked-memory study, not manufacturer HBM2 data.

sources.title: Semiconductor yield models using contagious distributions and their limiting forms
used_for: negative-binomial yield equation (1 + D0 A / alpha)^(-alpha) and clustered-defect rationale
sources.limitations: Equation source only; project defect-density and alpha values remain illustrative.

sources.title: Roofline: An Insightful Visual Performance Model for Floating-Point Programs and Multicore Architectures
sources.organization: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory / UC Berkeley
used_for: separate workload operational intensity, memory-bandwidth ceiling and compute ceiling
sources.limitations: Performance-bound methodology; does not establish HBM package cost.

sources.title: STOB hardware-cost design-space assumption
used_for: default numeric ranges where no public vendor manufacturing value exists
sources.limitations: These values are not supported by a vendor disclosure; they exist solely for sensitivity analysis and must not be cited as measured facts.

sources.title: STOB HBM2 PIM architecture configuration
sources.limitations: Geometry is estimated or illustrative, not vendor GDS.
